tasks.title: Implement the rsyncx stream adapter and the per-side exclude-rule computation, combination and size cap
steps: Write TS-14-8 and confirm it fails

In sandbox/internal/tarsafe export SymlinkEscapes(name, target string) bool (absolute target, or path.Join(path.Dir(name), target) cleaned leaves the root) and make Validator.Check call it, so tar and rsync share one symlink predicate

Create sandbox/internal/rsyncx/conn.go (no build constraint): small interfaces hostStream {Send, Recv, CloseSend, Context} and agentStream {Send, Recv, Context} over *sandboxpb.RsyncFrame, satisfied by the generated stream types and by test fakes; type Conn with constructors HostConn(st) and AgentConn(st) implementing io.ReadWriteCloser

Write: hold one mutex for the whole call, copy the input and send it as data frames of at most MaxDataChunk bytes in order, and add the bytes to a counter read by Sent() int64 (the host's rsync data bytes)

Read: return buffered bytes first, then Recv; a data frame refills the buffer; on the host a done frame stores its counts (Done() (*sandboxpb.RsyncDone, bool)) and Read returns io.EOF from then on; Recv io.EOF gives io.EOF; any other frame kind returns *FrameError{Kind} naming it (the host treats it as a malformed response, the agent as InvalidArgument)
Close: the host end calls CloseSend exactly once through sync.Once; the agent end only marks the Conn closed so later Writes fail

Create sandbox/internal/rsyncx/rules.go: RuleOptions{Ignore tools.IgnoreOptions; IncludeIgnored, ExcludeGit, File bool}, Compute(ctx, root string, opts) (RuleSet, error) and RuleSet{Ignored, Unreadable, Escaping []string; Git bool} with List(withIgnored bool) []string returning the sorted, deduplicated raw slash-relative rules plus `.git` when Git is set

Ignored part (skipped when IncludeIgnored or File): tools.NewWorkspace(root) and tools.Walk with IncludeHidden true and opts.Ignore give the visited set; a filepath.WalkDir pass over root adds every entry that is not visited, has no `.git` component, and whose parent is root or visited, then skips its subtree, so each ignored directory yields one rule at its highest level

In the same WalkDir pass, never following symlinks: a directory whose ReadDir fails or a regular file os.Open refuses becomes an Unreadable rule (subtree skipped); a symlink whose os.Readlink target SymlinkEscapes rejects relative to root becomes an Escaping rule; .git subtrees are scanned for escaping links when transferred, and skipped with Git = true when ExcludeGit is set

Combine(host, plan []string) []string: union, remove duplicates, sort by raw rule, then keep `.git` unanchored and turn every other rule into "/" + rule with a backslash before each `\`, `*`, `?` and `[`; CheckRuleSize(rules []string) error measures the sum of len(rule) and, above MaxRuleBytes, returns an error containing the measured size and `8 MiB`
